   221→
   222→class ParameterLocker:
   223→    """
   224→    Locks cognitive parameters for deterministic generation.
   225→
   226→    Implements:
   227→    - MAX3 bounded reflection
   228→    - Cognitive safety gating
   229→    - Deterministic checksums
   230→    - Paradigm selection based on mode
   231→    """
   232→
   233→    def __init__(self, max_reflections: int = 3, epsilon: float = 0.1):
   234→        """
   235→        Initialize locker.
   236→
   237→        Args:
   238→            max_reflections: Maximum reflection iterations (MAX3)
   239→            epsilon: Convergence threshold for stopping early
   240→
   241→        Note: reflection_count is now tracked in CognitiveState for batch-invariance.
   242→        """
   243→        self.max_reflections = max_reflections
   244→        self.epsilon = epsilon
   245→        self._current_lock: Optional[LockResult] = None
   246→
   247→    def lock(
   248→        self,
   249→        routing: RoutingResult,
   250→        burnout: BurnoutLevel,
   251→        energy: EnergyLevel,
   252→        altitude: Altitude,
   253→        requested_depth: ThinkDepth = ThinkDepth.STANDARD,
   254→        mode: str = "focused",
   255→        epistemic_tension: float = 0.0,
   256→        reflection_count: int = 0,
   257→        source_mode: str = "learn",  # v6.0.0
   258→        trail: Optional['OrchestraTrail'] = None,  # v7.0.0
   259→        task_type: str = ""  # v7.0.0
   260→    ) -> LockResult:
   261→        """
   262→        Lock parameters for generation.
   263→
   264→        ThinkingMachines [He2025]: Parameters locked BEFORE generation.
   265→        Batch-invariance: reflection_count passed from state snapshot,
   266→        not stored as instance state.
   267→        [GWM2026]: source_mode locks grounding decision.
   268→
   269→        v7.0.0: Trail-informed depth optimization within safety bounds.
   270→        IMPORTANT: Safety gates ALWAYS take precedence over trail suggestions.
   271→
   272→        Args:
   273→            routing: Result from expert router
   274→            burnout: Current burnout level
   275→            energy: Current energy level
   276→            altitude: Current altitude
   277→            requested_depth: User-requested thinking depth
   278→            mode: Current cognitive mode (for paradigm selection)
   279→            epistemic_tension: Current epistemic tension (for early stop)
   280→            reflection_count: Current reflection count (from CognitiveState snapshot)
   281→            source_mode: v6.0.0 - Grounding source mode (learn|access|hybrid)
   282→            trail: v7.0.0 - BCM trail for depth optimization (optional)
   283→            task_type: v7.0.0 - Task type for trail-based depth lookup
   284→
   285→        Returns:
   286→            LockResult with locked parameters
   287→        """
   288→        # =================================================================
   289→        # STEP 1: Determine paradigm based on mode
   290→        # =================================================================
   291→        paradigm = self._select_paradigm(routing.expert, mode)
   292→
   293→        # =================================================================
   294→        # STEP 2: Apply cognitive safety gating to thinking depth
   295→        # =================================================================
   296→        actual_depth, safety_capped = self._apply_safety_gating(
   297→            requested_depth, burnout, energy
   298→        )
   299→
   300→        # =================================================================
   301→        # STEP 2b (v7.0.0): Apply BCM trail optimization WITHIN safety bounds
   302→        # =================================================================
   303→        bcm_metadata = self._apply_bcm_depth_optimization(
   304→            actual_depth=actual_depth,
   305→            safety_cap=self._get_max_depth(burnout, energy),
   306→            expert=routing.expert.value,
   307→            task_type=task_type,
   308→            trail=trail
   309→        )
   310→
   311→        # If trail provided a better depth within safety bounds, use it
   312→        if bcm_metadata["optimized"] and bcm_metadata["suggested_depth"]:
   313→            suggested = bcm_metadata["suggested_depth"]
   314→            depth_order = [ThinkDepth.MINIMAL, ThinkDepth.STANDARD, ThinkDepth.DEEP, ThinkDepth.ULTRADEEP]
   315→            depth_map = {d.value: d for d in depth_order}
   316→
   317→            if suggested in depth_map:
   318→                suggested_depth = depth_map[suggested]
   319→                suggested_idx = depth_order.index(suggested_depth)
   320→                cap_idx = depth_order.index(self._get_max_depth(burnout, energy))
   321→
   322→                # Trail can adjust within safety bounds (never exceed cap)
   323→                if suggested_idx <= cap_idx:
   324→                    # Use trail suggestion (within safety bounds)
   325→                    actual_depth = suggested_depth
   326→                    logger.info(f"BCM trail adjusted depth: {suggested} (within safety cap)")
   327→
   328→        # =================================================================
   329→        # STEP 3: Check MAX3 and epsilon stopping
   330→        # =================================================================
   331→        converged = False
   332→        if epistemic_tension < self.epsilon and reflection_count > 0:
   333→            # Early convergence - signal to caller
   334→            logger.info(f"Early convergence at xi={epistemic_tension:.2f} < epsilon={self.epsilon}")
   335→            converged = True
   336→
   337→        if reflection_count >= self.max_reflections:
   338→            # MAX3 reached - force minimal depth
   339→            actual_depth = ThinkDepth.MINIMAL
   340→            safety_capped = True
   341→            logger.info(f"MAX3 reached ({reflection_count}/{self.max_reflections})")
   342→
   343→        # =================================================================
   344→        # STEP 4: Create locked params
   345→        # =================================================================
   346→        params = LockedParams(
   347→            expert=routing.expert.value,
   348→            paradigm=paradigm.value,
   349→            altitude=self._format_altitude(altitude),
   350→            think_depth=actual_depth.value,
   351→            source_mode=source_mode,  # v6.0.0
   352→            reflection_iteration=reflection_count
   353→        )
   354→
   355→        result = LockResult(
   356→            status=LockStatus.LOCKED,
   357→            params=params,
   358→            safety_capped=safety_capped,
   359→            original_depth=requested_depth.value if safety_capped else None,
   360→            converged=converged,
   361→            # v7.0.0: BCM metadata
   362→            bcm_optimized=bcm_metadata["optimized"],
   363→            bcm_suggested_depth=bcm_metadata["suggested_depth"],
   364→            bcm_trail_version=bcm_metadata["trail_version"],
   365→            bcm_depth_history_count=bcm_metadata["depth_history_count"]
   366→        )
   367→
   368→        self._current_lock = result
   369→        # NOTE: Counter increment now handled by caller (CognitiveOrchestrator)
   370→        # after batch_update() for batch-invariance
   371→
   372→        logger.info(f"Locked params: {params.to_anchor()}")
   373→        return result
   374→
   375→    def _select_paradigm(self, expert: Expert, mode: str) -> Paradigm:
   376→        """
   377→        Select paradigm based on expert and mode.
   378→
   379→        Per CLAUDE.md:
   380→        - Default: Cortex (hierarchical, explicit)
   381→        - Switch to Mycelium on "what if", exploring signals
   382→        """
   383→        # Socratic expert + exploring mode → Mycelium
   384→        if expert == Expert.SOCRATIC and mode in ("exploring", "teaching"):
   385→            return Paradigm.MYCELIUM
   386→
   387→        # Explicit mode signals
   388→        if mode == "exploring":
   389→            return Paradigm.MYCELIUM
   390→
   391→        # Default to Cortex
   392→        return Paradigm.CORTEX
   393→
   394→    def _apply_safety_gating(
   395→        self,
   396→        requested: ThinkDepth,
   397→        burnout: BurnoutLevel,
   398→        energy: EnergyLevel
   399→    ) -> tuple[ThinkDepth, bool]:
   400→        """
   401→        Apply cognitive safety gating to thinking depth.
   402→
   403→        Per CLAUDE.md:
   404→        - depleted → minimal
   405→        - low energy → standard
   406→        - RED/ORANGE burnout → standard
   407→        - high energy → ultradeep OK (if requested)
   408→
   409→        Safety state ALWAYS overrides user request. Can REDUCE, never increase.
   410→
   411→        Returns:
   412→            (actual_depth, was_capped)
   413→        """
   414→        max_allowed = self._get_max_depth(burnout, energy)
   415→
   416→        # Get depth order for comparison
   417→        depth_order = [ThinkDepth.MINIMAL, ThinkDepth.STANDARD, ThinkDepth.DEEP, ThinkDepth.ULTRADEEP]
   418→
   419→        requested_idx = depth_order.index(requested)
   420→        max_idx = depth_order.index(max_allowed)
   421→
   422→        if requested_idx > max_idx:
   423→            # Safety cap - reduce to max allowed
   424→            logger.info(f"Safety gating: {requested.value} → {max_allowed.value}")
   425→            return (max_allowed, True)
   426→
   427→        return (requested, False)
   428→
   429→    def _apply_bcm_depth_optimization(
   430→        self,
   431→        actual_depth: ThinkDepth,
   432→        safety_cap: ThinkDepth,
   433→        expert: str,
   434→        task_type: str,
   435→        trail: Optional['OrchestraTrail']
   436→    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
   437→        """
   438→        v7.0.0: Apply BCM trail-informed depth optimization.
   439→
   440→        CRITICAL: Safety cap is NEVER exceeded. Trail can only suggest
   441→        depths within the already-determined safety bounds.
   442→
   443→        ThinkingMachines [He2025] Compliance:
   444→        - Trail data is read-only during this phase
   445→        - Decision is deterministic given same inputs
   446→        - No side effects on trail during locking
   447→
   448→        Args:
   449→            actual_depth: Current depth after safety gating
   450→            safety_cap: Maximum allowed depth from safety gating
   451→            expert: Expert name
   452→            task_type: Task type for depth lookup
   453→            trail: BCM trail (optional)
   454→
   455→        Returns:
   456→            Dict with BCM metadata:
   457→            - optimized: bool - Whether trail influenced decision
   458→            - suggested_depth: str or None - Trail's suggestion
   459→            - trail_version: str - Trail version
   460→            - depth_history_count: int - Number of depth samples
   461→        """
   462→        # Default: no trail or no optimization
   463→        result = {
   464→            "optimized": False,
   465→            "suggested_depth": None,
   466→            "trail_version": "",
   467→            "depth_history_count": 0
   468→        }
   469→
   470→        if trail is None:
   471→            return result
   472→
   473→        # Set version from trail
   474→        result["trail_version"] = trail.version
   475→
   476→        # Build the key for depth history lookup (format: "expert:task_type")
   477→        depth_key = f"{expert}:{task_type}" if task_type else expert
   478→
   479→        # Check if trail has depth history for this expert
   480→        if not trail.has_depth_data(expert, task_type or None):
   481→            return result
   482→
   483→        # Get depth history count
   484→        if depth_key in trail.depth_history:
   485→            result["depth_history_count"] = len(trail.depth_history[depth_key])
   486→
   487→        # Get trail's optimal depth suggestion
   488→        # Pass safety_cap.value as string (trail expects string depths)
   489→        suggested = trail.get_optimal_depth(
   490→            expert=expert,
   491→            task_type=task_type,
   492→            fallback=actual_depth.value,
   493→            safety_cap=safety_cap.value
   494→        )
   495→
   496→        if suggested:
   497→            result["suggested_depth"] = suggested
   498→
   499→            # Only mark as optimized if suggestion differs from current
   500→            # and is within safety bounds
   501→            depth_order = ["minimal", "standard", "deep", "ultradeep"]
   502→            if suggested in depth_order:
   503→                suggested_idx = depth_order.index(suggested)
   504→                cap_idx = depth_order.index(safety_cap.value)
   505→
   506→                if suggested_idx <= cap_idx:
   507→                    result["optimized"] = True
   508→                    logger.debug(
   509→                        f"BCM trail suggests {suggested} for {expert}/{task_type} "
   510→                        f"(within cap {safety_cap.value})"
   511→                    )
   512→
   513→        return result
   514→
   515→    def _get_max_depth(self, burnout: BurnoutLevel, energy: EnergyLevel) -> ThinkDepth:
   516→        """
   517→        Get maximum allowed thinking depth based on state.
   518→
   519→        Cognitive Safety Gating (from CLAUDE.md):
   520→        - depleted → minimal
   521→        - low energy → standard
   522→        - RED burnout → minimal
   523→        - ORANGE burnout → standard
   524→        - high energy → ultradeep OK
   525→        """
   526→        # Energy depleted → minimal
   527→        if energy == EnergyLevel.DEPLETED:
   528→            return ThinkDepth.MINIMAL
   529→
   530→        # RED burnout → minimal
   531→        if burnout == BurnoutLevel.RED:
   532→            return ThinkDepth.MINIMAL
   533→
   534→        # Low energy OR ORANGE burnout → standard
   535→        if energy == EnergyLevel.LOW or burnout == BurnoutLevel.ORANGE:
   536→            return ThinkDepth.STANDARD
   537→
   538→        # High energy → ultradeep allowed
   539→        if energy == EnergyLevel.HIGH:
   540→            return ThinkDepth.ULTRADEEP
   541→
   542→        # Default → deep
   543→        return ThinkDepth.DEEP
   544→
   545→    def _format_altitude(self, altitude: Altitude) -> str:
   546→        """Format altitude for display."""
   547→        altitude_map = {
   548→            Altitude.VISION: "30000ft",
   549→            Altitude.ARCHITECTURE: "15000ft",
   550→            Altitude.COMPONENTS: "5000ft",
   551→            Altitude.GROUND: "Ground"
   552→        }
   553→        return altitude_map.get(altitude, "30000ft")
   554→
   555→    def reset(self) -> None:
   556→        """Reset locker state (for new task).
   557→
   558→        Note: reflection_count is now reset in CognitiveState for batch-invariance.
   559→        """
   560→        self._current_lock = None
   561→
   562→    def get_current_lock(self) -> Optional[LockResult]:
   563→        """Get current lock result."""
   564→        return self._current_lock

   106→
   107→def calculate_theta_m(total_strength: float, config: BCMConfig = DEFAULT_CONFIG) -> float:
   108→    """Calculate sliding modification threshold.
   109→
   110→    BCM homeostasis: theta DECREASES as activity increases.
   111→    """
   112→    if total_strength <= 0:
   113→        return config.base_threshold
   114→
   115→    ratio = total_strength / config.reference_strength
   116→    theta_m = config.base_threshold / (1 + ratio ** config.scaling_exponent)
   117→    min_theta = config.base_threshold * config.plasticity_min_threshold_ratio
   118→    return max(theta_m, min_theta)
   119→
   120→
   121→def calculate_saturation_factor(trail_strength: float, theta_m: float) -> float:
   122→    """Calculate saturation factor for reinforcement."""
   123→    if theta_m <= 0:
   124→        return 0.01
   125→    return 1.0 / (1.0 + trail_strength / theta_m)

   128→def apply_decay(trail: Trail, elapsed_minutes: float, config: BCMConfig = DEFAULT_CONFIG) -> None:
   129→    """Apply time-based decay to trail strength."""
   130→    if elapsed_minutes <= 0:
   131→        return
   132→
   133→    time_units = elapsed_minutes / config.decay_time_unit_minutes
   134→    decay_factor = (1 - trail.decay_rate) ** time_units
   135→    trail.strength = max(config.min_strength, trail.strength * decay_factor)

   148→        Effective reinforcement amount applied.
   149→    """
   150→    base_amount = config.reinforcement_amounts.get(reinforcement_type, 0.1)
   151→
   152→    # Calculate theta with plasticity boost
   153→    theta_m = calculate_theta_m(total_strength, config)
   154→    if plasticity_sigma > 0:
   155→        boost = plasticity_sigma * config.plasticity_reduction_scale
   156→        theta_m = theta_m * (1 + boost)
   157→
   158→    # Apply saturation
   159→    saturation = calculate_saturation_factor(trail.strength, theta_m)
   160→    effective = base_amount * saturation
   161→
   162→    # Update trail
   163→    old_strength = trail.strength
   164→    trail.strength = max(config.min_strength,
   165→                         min(config.max_strength, trail.strength + effective))
   166→    trail.update_count += 1
   167→    trail.last_update = datetime.now()
   168→
   169→    return trail.strength - old_strength
   170→

   117→    def __post_init__(self):

   124→    def _compute_checksum(self) -> str:

   132→        v6.0.0: Includes source_mode in checksum

   134→        data = json.dumps({
   135→            "expert": self.expert,
   136→            "paradigm": self.paradigm,
   137→            "altitude": self.altitude,
   138→            "think_depth": self.think_depth,
   139→            "source_mode": self.source_mode,  # v6.0.0
   140→            # NOTE: reflection_iteration intentionally excluded for batch-invariance
   141→        }, sort_keys=True)
   142→        return hashlib.md5(data.encode()).hexdigest()[:6]
   143→
   144→    def _compute_session_checksum(self) -> str:
   145→        """
   146→        Compute session-aware checksum including iteration.
   147→
   148→        Used for debugging/tracing, not for batch-invariance verification.
   149→        """
   150→        data = json.dumps({
   151→            "expert": self.expert,
   152→            "paradigm": self.paradigm,
   153→            "altitude": self.altitude,
   154→            "think_depth": self.think_depth,
   155→            "source_mode": self.source_mode,  # v6.0.0
   156→            "reflection_iteration": self.reflection_iteration
   157→        }, sort_keys=True)
   158→        return hashlib.md5(data.encode()).hexdigest()[:6]

   165→        """
   166→        return f"[EXEC:{self.checksum}|{self.expert}|{self.paradigm}|{self.altitude}|{self.think_depth}|{self.source_mode}]"
   167→
   168→    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:

   182→    def can_reflect(self) -> bool:

   184→        return self.reflection_iteration < self.max_reflections

    57→class PromptCanonicalizer:
    58→    """
    59→    Normalize prompts to canonical byte representation.
    60→
    61→    He2025 analog: Fixing the input tile boundaries ensures the same
    62→    logical query always has the same physical representation.
    63→
    64→    Canonicalization steps (FIXED order):
    65→    1. Unicode NFC normalization
    66→    2. Strip trailing whitespace per line
    67→    3. Collapse multiple blank lines to single
    68→    4. Collapse multiple spaces to single (outside code blocks)
    69→    5. Sort tool definitions alphabetically by name
    70→    6. Deterministic JSON serialization for structured content
    71→    """
    72→
    73→    def canonicalize(self, prompt: str) -> str:
    74→        """
    75→        Normalize a prompt to canonical form.
    76→
    77→        Args:
    78→            prompt: Raw prompt string
    79→
    80→        Returns:
    81→            Canonical prompt string
    82→        """
    83→        if not prompt:
    84→            return ""
    85→
    86→        result = prompt
    87→
    88→        # 1. Unicode NFC normalization
    89→        result = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", result)
    90→
    91→        # 2-4: Process outside code blocks only
    92→        # Split on code block markers first to preserve code block content
    93→        parts = re.split(r"(```[\s\S]*?```)", result)
    94→        processed_parts = []
    95→        for part in parts:
    96→            if part.startswith("```"):
    97→                # Code block — preserve exactly
    98→                processed_parts.append(part)
    99→            else:
   100→                # Non-code: strip trailing whitespace, collapse blank lines, normalize spaces
   101→                lines = part.split("\n")
   102→                lines = [line.rstrip() for line in lines]
   103→
   104→                # Collapse multiple blank lines to single
   105→                collapsed = []
   106→                prev_blank = False
   107→                for line in lines:
   108→                    is_blank = line.strip() == ""
   109→                    if is_blank and prev_blank:
   110→                        continue
   111→                    collapsed.append(line)
   112→                    prev_blank = is_blank
   113→
   114→                # Collapse multiple spaces to single
   115→                collapsed = [re.sub(r"  +", " ", line) for line in collapsed]
   116→                processed_parts.append("\n".join(collapsed))
   117→
   118→        result = "".join(processed_parts)
   119→
   120→        # 5. Sort tool definitions if present
   121→        result = self._sort_tool_definitions(result)
   122→
   123→        return result.rstrip("\n")
   124→
   125→    def canonical_hash(self, prompt: str) -> str:
   126→        """
   127→        SHA-256 hash of canonical form — used as cache key.
   128→
   129→        Args:
   130→            prompt: Raw or canonical prompt string
   131→
   132→        Returns:
   133→            Hex string of first 32 chars of SHA-256 hash
   134→        """
   135→        canonical = self.canonicalize(prompt)
   136→        return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:32]
   137→
   138→    def _normalize_whitespace(self, text: str) -> str:
   139→        """Collapse multiple spaces to single outside code blocks."""
   140→        # Split on code block markers
   141→        parts = re.split(r"(```[\s\S]*?```)", text)
   142→        normalized = []
   143→        for i, part in enumerate(parts):
   144→            if part.startswith("```"):
   145→                # Code block — preserve exactly
   146→                normalized.append(part)
   147→            else:
   148→                # Non-code — collapse spaces (but preserve newlines)
   149→                lines = part.split("\n")
   150→                lines = [re.sub(r"  +", " ", line) for line in lines]
   151→                normalized.append("\n".join(lines))
   152→        return "".join(normalized)
   153→
   154→    def _sort_tool_definitions(self, text: str) -> str:
   155→        """Sort tool definition blocks alphabetically by name."""
   156→        # Match JSON tool arrays: "tools": [...]
   157→        tool_pattern = r'"tools"\s*:\s*\[([^\]]*)\]'
   158→        match = re.search(tool_pattern, text, re.DOTALL)
   159→        if not match:
   160→            return text
   161→
   162→        try:
   163→            # Extract, parse, sort, and replace
   164→            tools_str = "[" + match.group(1) + "]"
   165→            tools = json.loads(tools_str)
   166→            tools.sort(key=lambda t: t.get("name", ""))
   167→            sorted_str = json.dumps(tools, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
   168→            return text[:match.start()] + '"tools":' + sorted_str + text[match.end():]
   169→        except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
   170→            return text

   117→def on_session_start(calibration: CalibrationResult = None,
   118→                     skip_calibration: bool = False) -> SessionStartResult:
   119→    """
   120→    Initialize cognitive tracking for a new session.
   121→
   122→    This hook:
   123→    1. Creates or loads the cognitive stage (USD-native)
   124→    2. Applies calibration if provided
   125→    3. Returns cognitive context for prompt injection
   126→
   127→    Args:

   129→        skip_calibration: If True, use defaults without asking
   130→
   131→    Returns:

   133→    """
   134→    # Create/load cognitive stage
   135→    stage = create_cognitive_stage()
   136→
   137→    # Apply calibration
   138→    if calibration:
   139→        stage.calibrate(
   140→            focus_level=calibration.focus,
   141→            urgency=calibration.urgency,
   142→            energy_estimate=calibration.energy,
   143→        )
   144→    elif skip_calibration:
   145→        # Use defaults
   146→        calibration = CalibrationResult(skipped=True)
   147→    else:
   148→        # Return questions for user - actual calibration happens after
   149→        calibration = CalibrationResult()  # Defaults until answered
   150→
   151→    # Get cognitive context for prompt injection
   152→    context = stage.get_prompt_context()
   153→
   154→    # Save initial state
   155→    stage.save()
   156→
   157→    result = SessionStartResult(
   158→        cognitive_context=context,
   159→        calibration=calibration,
   160→        stage_checksum=stage.checksum(),
   161→        using_pxr=stage.using_pxr,
   162→    )
   163→
   164→    logger.info(f"Session started: checksum={result.stage_checksum}, pxr={result.using_pxr}")
   165→    return result

   182→                {"label": opt["label"], "description": opt["description"]}

   191→    """

   213→    return result

    11→## Overview
    12→
    13→Orchestra v5.0 is a cognitive orchestration system that applies USD (Universal Scene Description) composition semantics to cognitive state management, with ThinkingMachines-compliant deterministic execution.
    14→
    15→## Core Design Principles
    16→
    17→### 1. USD as Universal State Description
    18→
    19→Pixar's USD was designed to resolve conflicting opinions in complex 3D pipelines. We apply the same composition semantics to AI agent orchestration:
    20→
    21→```
    22→USD Concept          → Cognitive Application
    23→─────────────────────────────────────────────
    24→Scene graph          → Cognitive architecture
    25→Prim attributes      → Behavioral parameters
    26→Composition arcs     → Priority resolution
    27→Variants             → Mode switching
    28→Layers               → Cognitive subsystems
    29→Payloads             → Domain knowledge
    30→```
    31→
    32→### 2. LIVRPS Priority Resolution
    33→
    34→Memory and state conflicts resolve using LIVRPS priority (strongest to weakest):
    35→
    36→```
    37→Layer        Priority  Description                 Compressible
    38→────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    39→LOCAL           6      Session state               Yes (first)
    40→INHERITS        5      Parent task context         Yes (second)
    41→VARIANTSETS     4      Memory modes                No
    42→REFERENCES      3      Cross-session calibration   No
    43→PAYLOADS        2      Domain knowledge            Unload only
    44→SPECIALIZES     1      Principles (constitutional) NEVER
    45→```
    46→
    47→### 3. Deterministic Routing
    48→
    49→All routing decisions are deterministic via hash-based selection:
    50→
    51→```python
    52→expert_index = int(hashlib.md5(task.encode()).hexdigest(), 16) % len(experts)
    53→```
    54→
    55→Same input → Same routing → Same output.

   102→## Data Flow
   103→
   104→### 5-Phase NEXUS Pipeline (ThinkingMachines Compliant)
   105→
   106→```
   107→┌─────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐
   108→│   DETECT    │ ──▶ │   CASCADE   │ ──▶ │    LOCK     │
   109→│   (PRISM)   │     │  (ADHD_MoE) │     │   (MAX3)    │
   110→└─────────────┘     └─────────────┘     └─────────────┘
   111→                                               │
   112→┌─────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐            │
   113→│   UPDATE    │ ◀── │   EXECUTE   │ ◀──────────┘
   114→│  (RC^+xi)   │     │  (Claude)   │
   115→└─────────────┘     └─────────────┘
   116→
   117→1. DETECT    → PRISM extracts signals (emotional > mode > domain > task)
   118→2. CASCADE   → Safety gates + ADHD_MoE routing (7 experts, fixed priority)
   119→3. LOCK      → MAX3 bounded reflection + parameter freezing
   120→4. EXECUTE   → Generation with locked parameters
   121→5. UPDATE    → RC^+xi convergence tracking (xi_n = ||A_{n+1} - A_n||_2)
   122→```

   131→| Reproducible checksums | `json.dumps(..., sort_keys=True)` + MD5 |

   177→## Memory Architecture (ECHO Curator)
   178→
   179→### LIVRPS Memory Layers
   180→
   181→![LIVRPS Memory Layers](images/livrps-layers.png)
   182→
   183→*Figure: LIVRPS memory hierarchy showing six layers from highest to lowest priority. LOCAL (session state) has highest priority, while SPECIALIZES (principles) has lowest priority but is immutable. Compression policies vary by layer to optimize context usage.*
   184→
   185→**Layer Policies:**
   186→- **LOCAL** (Session state): Compress aggressively, reset between sessions
   187→- **INHERITS** (Parent context): Compress, inherit from higher layers
   188→- **VARIANTSETS** (Memory modes): Protected, switch between named modes
   189→- **REFERENCES** (Calibration): Protected, external reference data
   190→- **PAYLOADS** (Domain knowledge): Can be unloaded for memory management
   191→- **SPECIALIZES** (Principles): **NEVER** compressed or modified (immutable)
   192→
   193→```python
   194→memory_layers = {
   195→    "specializes": {},   # Principles - NEVER compressed
   196→    "payloads": {},      # Domain knowledge - unloadable
   197→    "references": {},    # Calibration - protected
   198→    "variantsets": {},   # Memory modes - protected
   199→    "inherits": {},      # Parent context - compressible
   200→    "local": {}          # Session state - compresses first
   201→}
   202→```
   203→
   204→### Memory Modes
   205→
   206→| Mode | Search Depth | Search Breadth | Use When |
   207→|------|--------------|----------------|----------|
   208→| `focused_recall` | Deep | Narrow | Debugging, implementation |
   209→| `exploratory_recall` | Shallow | Wide | Brainstorming, research |
   210→| `recovery_recall` | Principles only | Minimal | Burnout, error states |
   211→
   212→### Compression Order
   213→
   214→When memory pressure occurs:
   215→1. Compress LOCAL (session state)
   216→2. Compress INHERITS (parent context)
   217→3. Unload PAYLOADS (domain knowledge)
   218→4. NEVER compress: VARIANTSETS, REFERENCES, SPECIALIZES

   107→def calculate_theta_m(total_strength: float, config: BCMConfig = DEFAULT_CONFIG) -> float:
   108→    """Calculate sliding modification threshold.
   109→
   110→    BCM homeostasis: theta DECREASES as activity increases.
   111→    """
   112→    if total_strength <= 0:
   113→        return config.base_threshold
   114→
   115→    ratio = total_strength / config.reference_strength
   116→    theta_m = config.base_threshold / (1 + ratio ** config.scaling_exponent)
   117→    min_theta = config.base_threshold * config.plasticity_min_threshold_ratio
   118→    return max(theta_m, min_theta)
   119→
   120→
   121→def calculate_saturation_factor(trail_strength: float, theta_m: float) -> float:
   122→    """Calculate saturation factor for reinforcement."""
   123→    if theta_m <= 0:
   124→        return 0.01
   125→    return 1.0 / (1.0 + trail_strength / theta_m)

   128→def apply_decay(trail: Trail, elapsed_minutes: float, config: BCMConfig = DEFAULT_CONFIG) -> None:
   129→    """Apply time-based decay to trail strength."""
   130→    if elapsed_minutes <= 0:
   131→        return
   132→
   133→    time_units = elapsed_minutes / config.decay_time_unit_minutes
   134→    decay_factor = (1 - trail.decay_rate) ** time_units
   135→    trail.strength = max(config.min_strength, trail.strength * decay_factor)

   138→def reinforce_trail(
   139→    trail: Trail,
   140→    total_strength: float,
   141→    reinforcement_type: str = "success",
   142→    plasticity_sigma: float = 0.0,
   143→    config: BCMConfig = DEFAULT_CONFIG
   144→) -> float:
   145→    """Reinforce a trail with BCM saturation.
   146→
   147→    Returns:
   148→        Effective reinforcement amount applied.
   149→    """
   150→    base_amount = config.reinforcement_amounts.get(reinforcement_type, 0.1)
   151→
   152→    # Calculate theta with plasticity boost
   153→    theta_m = calculate_theta_m(total_strength, config)
   154→    if plasticity_sigma > 0:
   155→        boost = plasticity_sigma * config.plasticity_reduction_scale
   156→        theta_m = theta_m * (1 + boost)
   157→
   158→    # Apply saturation
   159→    saturation = calculate_saturation_factor(trail.strength, theta_m)
   160→    effective = base_amount * saturation
   161→
   162→    # Update trail
   163→    old_strength = trail.strength
   164→    trail.strength = max(config.min_strength,
   165→                         min(config.max_strength, trail.strength + effective))
   166→    trail.update_count += 1
   167→    trail.last_update = datetime.now()
   168→
   169→    return trail.strength - old_strength

     6→
     7→This agent:

    34→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

    37→# =============================================================================
    38→# Synthesis Modes
    39→# =============================================================================
    40→
    41→class SynthesisMode(Enum):
    42→    """Modes of synthesis operation."""
    43→    COMBINE = "combine"        # Merge into unified response
    44→    RANK = "rank"              # Rank and prioritize
    45→    RESOLVE = "resolve"        # Resolve conflicts

    49→# =============================================================================

    51→# =============================================================================
    52→
    53→# Context budget: max items per list key during _combine() accumulation.
    54→# Prevents unbounded list growth when many agents return large lists.
    55→MAX_COMBINE_LIST_SIZE = 200
    56→
    57→# Agent categories for LIVRPS-style priority resolution
    58→AGENT_PRIORITY = {
    59→    # LOCAL (session state - highest priority)
    60→    "cognitive_state": 1,

    62→    # INHERITS (context from parent)
    63→    "echo_curator": 2,

    75→    # SPECIALIZES (foundational - lowest override priority but always consulted)

   113→            "coherence_score": self.coherence_score,
   114→            "confidence_score": self.confidence_score,
   115→            "execution_time_ms": self.execution_time_ms,
   116→            "checksum": self.checksum
   117→        }
   118→
   119→
   120→# =============================================================================
   121→# Synthesis Agent
   122→# =============================================================================
   123→
   124→class SynthesisAgent:
   125→    """
   126→    Worker agent that synthesizes outputs from multiple agents.
   127→
   128→    Produces real, actionable synthesis - not just metadata.
   129→    """
   130→
   131→    def __init__(self):
   132→        """Initialize synthesis agent."""
   133→        self.name = "synthesis_agent"
   134→        self.logger = logging.getLogger(f"Agent.{self.name}")
   135→
   136→    async def execute(self, task: str, context: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
   137→        """
   138→        Execute synthesis operation.
   139→
   140→        Args:
   141→            task: Synthesis task description
   142→            context: Execution context with agent_results to synthesize
   143→
   144→        Returns:
   145→            Dict containing synthesis results
   146→        """
   147→        import time
   148→        start_time = time.time()
   149→
   150→        self.logger.info(f"Synthesis agent executing: {task[:100]}...")
   151→
   152→        # Get agent results from context
   153→        agent_results = context.get("agent_results", {})
   154→
   155→        if not agent_results:
   156→            return {
   157→                "error": "No agent results to synthesize",
   158→                "agents_synthesized": 0
   159→            }
   160→
   161→        # Detect synthesis mode
   162→        mode = self._detect_mode(task, agent_results)
   163→
   164→        # Execute appropriate synthesis
   165→        if mode == SynthesisMode.COMBINE:
   166→            result = await self._combine(agent_results, context)
   167→        elif mode == SynthesisMode.RANK:
   168→            result = await self._rank(agent_results, context)
   169→        elif mode == SynthesisMode.RESOLVE:
   170→            result = await self._resolve(agent_results, context)
   171→        else:  # SUMMARIZE
   172→            result = await self._summarize(agent_results, context)
   173→
   174→        result.mode = mode
   175→        result.agents_synthesized = len(agent_results)
   176→        result.execution_time_ms = (time.time() - start_time) * 1000
   177→        result.checksum = self._compute_checksum(result)
   178→
   179→        self.logger.info(
   180→            f"Synthesis complete: {result.agents_synthesized} agents, "
   181→            f"coherence={result.coherence_score:.2f}"
   182→        )
   183→
   184→        return result.to_dict()
   185→
   186→    def _detect_mode(self, task: str, agent_results: Dict) -> SynthesisMode:
   187→        """Detect synthesis mode from task."""
   188→        task_lower = task.lower()
   189→
   190→        if any(kw in task_lower for kw in ["conflict", "resolve", "disagree", "differ"]):
   191→            return SynthesisMode.RESOLVE
   192→
   193→        if any(kw in task_lower for kw in ["rank", "priority", "best", "order", "top"]):
   194→            return SynthesisMode.RANK
   195→
   196→        if any(kw in task_lower for kw in ["summary", "brief", "short", "condense"]):
   197→            return SynthesisMode.SUMMARIZE
   198→
   199→        # Default to combine
   200→        return SynthesisMode.COMBINE

   101→        # Add sorted prim content hashes if available
   102→        if prims:

   104→            for prim in prims:
